message: Qué angustia ver a los vecinos levantando sus cosas. Aquí en Kennedy el agua se está quedando frente a varios portones; si tienen familia por el sector, avísenle. #inundacion #Bogota

attachments.alt_text: Synthetic AI-generated original image for post-0003: Horizontal imperfect smartphone photograph from the dry sheltered entrance of a red-brick residential row in Kennedy, Bogotá, Colombia. Neighbors in normal rain jackets, faces indistinct, lifting a small table and bags onto a raised doorstep because murky rainwater is collecting along several metal garage gates. Emphasize the domestic objects, a burgundy garage door and several damp entrances; houses remain standing. Ordinary localized shallow street flooding, not a catastrophic flood.
